mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a U-trough and a tubular pipe screw conveyor?

acceptedAnswer.text: U-trough conveyors feature a removable bolted top cover along their entire length, making them the standard choice for horizontal or low-incline applications (up to 15°). They provide easy access for cleaning, washdown, and inspecting internal hanger bearings. In contrast, tubular pipe conveyors enclose the rotating helical screw inside a fully sealed round pipe casing. They are mandatory for steep inclines (15° to 45°), pressure-tight connections, toxic or hygroscopic chemicals, and outdoor installations where weatherproofing and zero dust emission are paramount.

mainEntity.name: What determines the maximum recommended trough cross-sectional loading percentage?

acceptedAnswer.text: According to CEMA standards, the trough filling percentage must be strictly calibrated to material abrasiveness and flowability. For light, free-flowing, non-abrasive materials like grain or hydrated lime, a 45% trough loading (Class A) is acceptable. For medium-abrasion granular solids like dry silica sand, coal, or fertilizer prills, loading is limited to 30% (Class B). For severe abrasive, dense minerals such as quartz fines, alumina, or iron ore, loading must never exceed 15% (Class C) while reducing screw rotational speed below 40 RPM to prevent rapid flight wear and intermediate hanger bearing fouling.

mainEntity.name: How does Minerals Solutions isolate shaft bearings from abrasive material intrusion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our screw conveyors utilize external flanged plummer block bearings mounted on dedicated standoff brackets spaced 50mm to 100mm away from the trough end plates. The shaft penetration through the end plate is sealed with an industrial split-gland stuffing box packed with self-lubricating braided PTFE or graphite packing rings, with optional air-purge lantern rings. This physical standoff ensures that even if a seal experiences packing wear, falling material discharges harmlessly to the ground rather than migrating into the bearing housing, completely eliminating premature bearing failure.

mainEntity.name: Can the MS-SC Series handle sticky, cohesive, or semi-solid wet cake materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. For cohesive bulk solids such as centrifuge dewatered cake, bio-compost, bentonite sludge, and hygroscopic fertilizer pastes, we replace standard continuous flights with open-center ribbon flights or adjustable paddle screws. Ribbon flights eliminate the solid center pipe surface where sticky material tends to build up and wrap around, allowing sticky masses to roll through the annular space without causing blockages or motor overloads.

What is an industrial screw conveyor? An industrial screw conveyor (also known as an auger conveyor or spiral feeder) is a positive-displacement bulk material handling machine that transports powders, slurries, and granular solids along horizontal or inclined paths up to 30 degrees. Fabricated in Zak GIDC, Dahegam in heavy U-trough or tubular pipe configurations, the conveyor incorporates continuous helical flighting (100mm to 600mm diameter) welded to a heavy-gauge central torque shaft. Driven by high-efficiency IE3 geared motors with spherical roller hanger bearings, the unit handles abrasive materials like silica sand, fly ash, cement, and hot fertilizer salts at 3 to 50 TPH. Completely sealed dust-tight bolted covers with silicone gaskets and gland-packing shaft seals eliminate fugitive dust emissions and external product contamination in rigorous continuous manufacturing plant operations across mineral and chemical industrial facilities in India. Containment & Metering Physics Enclosed Dust-Tight Powder & Granular Material Transport Open belt conveyors create hazardous airborne fugitive dust when handling fine powders, fly ash, and toxic minerals. Minerals Solutions screw conveyors seal bulk materials inside continuous gasketed housings, protecting workforce health and eliminating raw material shrinkage. Zero Fugitive Dust Emissions Continuous rubber or ceramic-fiber gasketing between trough flanges and removable cover plates ensures 100% airborne containment, complying with PCB workplace air quality limits for cement, silica, and hazardous chemical plants. Precision Volumetric Dosing Unlike gravity slides, screw rotation delivers a constant linear volumetric displacement per revolution. Coupled with variable frequency inverter drives (VFD), the conveyor doubles as a precise continuous feeder with ±2% batching repeatability. Compact Mechanical Footprint Requires zero return belt run, tensioning towers, or idler frames. The self-contained trough installs directly beneath hoppers, bag filters, cyclone discharges, and rotary dryers where overhead clearance is severely restricted. How do I choose between a U-trough and a tubular pipe screw conveyor? U-trough conveyors feature a removable bolted top cover along their entire length, making them the standard choice for horizontal or low-incline applications (up to 15°). They provide easy access for cleaning, washdown, and inspecting internal hanger bearings. In contrast, tubular pipe conveyors enclose the rotating helical screw inside a fully sealed round pipe casing. They are mandatory for steep inclines (15° to 45°), pressure-tight connections, toxic or hygroscopic chemicals, and outdoor installations where weatherproofing and zero dust emission are paramount. 0 2 . What determines the maximum recommended trough cross-sectional loading percentage? According to CEMA standards, the trough filling percentage must be strictly calibrated to material abrasiveness and flowability. For light, free-flowing, non-abrasive materials like grain or hydrated lime, a 45% trough loading (Class A) is acceptable. For medium-abrasion granular solids like dry silica sand, coal, or fertilizer prills, loading is limited to 30% (Class B). For severe abrasive, dense minerals such as quartz fines, alumina, or iron ore, loading must never exceed 15% (Class C) while reducing screw rotational speed below 40 RPM to prevent rapid flight wear and intermediate hanger bearing fouling. 0 3 . How does Minerals Solutions isolate shaft bearings from abrasive material intrusion? Our screw conveyors utilize external flanged plummer block bearings mounted on dedicated standoff brackets spaced 50mm to 100mm away from the trough end plates. The shaft penetration through the end plate is sealed with an industrial split-gland stuffing box packed with self-lubricating braided PTFE or graphite packing rings, with optional air-purge lantern rings. This physical standoff ensures that even if a seal experiences packing wear, falling material discharges harmlessly to the ground rather than migrating into the bearing housing, completely eliminating premature bearing failure. 0 4 . Can the MS-SC Series handle sticky, cohesive, or semi-solid wet cake materials? Yes. For cohesive bulk solids such as centrifuge dewatered cake, bio-compost, bentonite sludge, and hygroscopic fertilizer pastes, we replace standard continuous flights with open-center ribbon flights or adjustable paddle screws. Ribbon flights eliminate the solid center pipe surface where sticky material tends to build up and wrap around, allowing sticky masses to roll through the annular space without causing blockages or motor overloads. mainEntity.name: Why should I choose forged alloy steel trunnion rollers over cheaper cast iron rollers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cast iron rollers suffer from inherent internal casting porosity, microscopic shrinkage cavities, and low tensile strength. When subjected to the immense cyclic Hertzian contact pressures generated by a rotating dryer or kiln (often exceeding 600 to 800 MPa), cast rollers develop subsurface micro-cracks that rapidly propagate into catastrophic spalling, brittle rim fractures, and sudden axle shearing. In contrast, our forged EN-8, EN-9, and 42CrMo4 rollers undergo extreme hydraulic press reduction that aligns grain boundaries tangentially, completely eliminating internal voids and delivering superior fatigue endurance that lasts 3 to 5 times longer than cast alternatives.

mainEntity.name: Why is the surface hardness of the support roller calibrated slightly softer than the riding tyre?

acceptedAnswer.text: In mechanical running gear design, the sacrificial wear principle must be strictly maintained. A rotary dryer riding tyre (riding ring) is permanently welded or shim-mounted around the rotating drum shell; replacing a damaged tyre requires weeks of plant downtime, heavy crane rigging, and high capital expense. Therefore, support rollers are induction-hardened to 280–320 BHN, while riding tyres are hardened to 320–360 BHN (a deliberate 30 to 40 BHN differential). This ensures that normal rolling fatigue wear occurs on the easily replaceable, lower-cost support rollers rather than damaging the primary drum tyre.

mainEntity.name: What causes taper wear or hourglass grooving on support rollers, and how do we prevent it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Taper wear (where one side of the roller face wears down faster than the other) and hourglass hollow grooving are caused by improper roller skewing during axial thrust balancing, or by allowing the drum to run stationary without axial float. When millwrights over-skew rollers to force the drum uphill, high localized edge contact pressures strip the metal. Minerals Solutions prevents this by machining crown-relieved chamfers on roller outer edges and providing precision baseplate jackscrews that allow millwrights to set parallel skew angles to within 0.05 mm using dial indicators or laser alignment tools.

mainEntity.name: Can Minerals Solutions manufacture replacement support rollers from sample parts or custom drawings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our specialized heavy engineering facility in Zak GIDC, Dahegam specializes in rapid-turnaround aftermarket reverse engineering. If original equipment manufacturer (OEM) drawings are unavailable, you can provide key field dimensions (roller diameter, face width, shaft diameter, bearing centers, and step diameters) or ship a worn sample roller to our workshop. Our engineers generate certified 3D CAD fabrication drawings, verify material chemistry via optical emission spectrometry, and machine replacement assemblies in as little as 5 to 7 working days for emergency plant breakdowns.

What is a rotary dryer support roller assembly? A rotary dryer support roller assembly (also termed a trunnion roller, carrying roller, or kiln cradle wheel) is a heavy-duty mechanical running gear component engineered to support the dynamic rotating mass of rotary dryers, coolers, calciners, and kilns. Precision machined in Zak GIDC, Dahegam from solid forged alloy steel billets (EN-8, EN-9, or 42CrMo4/EN-19), the roller tyre undergoes rigorous induction hardening to 280-320 BHN and 100% ultrasonic flaw inspection per ASTM A388 standards. Mounted on high-strength forged steel shafts supported by heavy-duty self-aligning spherical roller bearings in cast steel pillow blocks, roller assemblies withstand dynamic radial loads up to 60 tonnes per wheelset. Precision dual-axis spherical alignment prevents uneven shell riding, tyre scalloping, and drive girth gear vibration under high thermal continuous operating conditions. Heavy Forging Science & Grain Flow Precision Metallurgy: EN-8, EN-9 & 42CrMo4 Alloy Forgings Inferior cast iron support rollers are the leading cause of sudden catastrophic rim shearing and unplanned plant outages. Minerals Solutions manufactures support rollers exclusively from open-die forged carbon alloy billets with continuous tangential grain flow: Continuous Tangential Grain Flow Open-die hydraulic forging compresses raw steel billets by a minimum 3:1 reduction ratio. This process closes all internal ingot porosity, aligns grain boundaries circumferentially along the rolling surface, and increases impact fracture toughness by over 250% compared to sand-cast iron rollers. Calibrated 30-40 BHN Hardness Delta In rotating machinery physics, the support roller must act as the sacrificial member. We precision-harden rollers to 280–320 BHN against 320–360 BHN tyres. This controlled differential prevents tyre scalloping, eliminating the massive capital expenditure of cutting off and replacing a welded drum riding ring. 100% Ultrasonic Flaw Testing (NDT) Every forged blank is subjected to rigorous ultrasonic testing (UT) in accordance with ASTM A388 / IS 2478 standards. Digital pulse-echo probes scan 100% of the internal volume, certifying complete freedom from sub-surface inclusions, hydrogen flakes, and thermal cracks prior to finish machining. Thermal Heat Treatment & Stress Relief Induction Hardening (280–320 BHN) & Stress Relief Through-hardening makes rollers brittle and prone to catastrophic rim fracture under shock loads. Minerals Solutions applies precision medium-frequency induction scanning that creates a glass-hard, wear-resistant outer skin while preserving a ductile, shock-absorbing inner core. 3mm to 5mm Effective Case Depth Induction heating coils heat the rolling circumference above 860°C followed by immediate high-pressure polymer quenchant spray. The resulting martensitic case depth (3–5mm) withstands years of heavy continuous rolling without peeling or spalling. Sub-Zero Tempering & Stress Relieving Immediately following induction quenching, rollers undergo 6-hour electric furnace tempering at 220°C to relieve residual thermal stresses, stabilize retained austenite, and eliminate dimensional distortion during subsequent precision grinding. Shaft Normalizing & Radiused Fillets Central drive and idler axles are forged from EN-9 / 40Cr carbon steel, normalized to refine grain size, and machined with generous transition fillet radii (>15mm) to eliminate stress concentration notches that trigger fatigue failure. Incorrect skew or uneven loading will destroy even the highest-grade replacement within months: 01 Taper / Conical Wear Root Cause: Support roller axis is not parallel to the drum centerline. Over-skewing forces one edge to take 80%+ of the total contact load. Remedy: Reset parallel axis using dial indicators; maintain equal roller skew. 02 Surface Pitting & Spalling Root Cause: Metal fatigue caused by excessive Hertzian shear stress, low surface hardness (<240 BHN), or internal casting porosity. Why is the surface hardness of the support roller calibrated slightly softer than the riding tyre? In mechanical running gear design, the sacrificial wear principle must be strictly maintained. A rotary dryer riding tyre (riding ring) is permanently welded or shim-mounted around the rotating drum shell; replacing a damaged tyre requires weeks of plant downtime, heavy crane rigging, and high capital expense. Therefore, support rollers are induction-hardened to 280–320 BHN, while riding tyres are hardened to 320–360 BHN (a deliberate 30 to 40 BHN differential). This ensures that normal rolling fatigue wear occurs on the easily replaceable, lower-cost support rollers rather than damaging the primary drum tyre. 0 3 . What causes taper wear or hourglass grooving on support rollers, and how do we prevent it? Taper wear (where one side of the roller face wears down faster than the other) and hourglass hollow grooving are caused by improper roller skewing during axial thrust balancing, or by allowing the drum to run stationary without axial float. When millwrights over-skew rollers to force the drum uphill, high localized edge contact pressures strip the metal. Minerals Solutions prevents this by machining crown-relieved chamfers on roller outer edges and providing precision baseplate jackscrews that allow millwrights to set parallel skew angles to within 0.05 mm using dial indicators or laser alignment tools. 0 4 . Can Minerals Solutions manufacture replacement support rollers from sample parts or custom drawings? Yes. Our specialized heavy engineering facility in Zak GIDC, Dahegam specializes in rapid-turnaround aftermarket reverse engineering. If original equipment manufacturer (OEM) drawings are unavailable, you can provide key field dimensions (roller diameter, face width, shaft diameter, bearing centers, and step diameters) or ship a worn sample roller to our workshop. Our engineers generate certified 3D CAD fabrication drawings, verify material chemistry via optical emission spectrometry, and machine replacement assemblies in as little as 5 to 7 working days for emergency plant breakdowns. mainEntity.name: How do 20°, 30°, and 35° troughing angles affect bulk material carrying capacity?

acceptedAnswer.text: The troughing angle formed by the two wing rollers relative to the horizontal center roller dictates the cross-sectional area of bulk material that can be conveyed without edge spillage. A standard 20° trough angle is ideal for flat, lightweight, or sticky materials with low surcharge angles. Moving to a 30° trough angle increases cross-sectional payload capacity by approximately 18% and represents the Indian quarry industry standard. Transitioning to a deep 35° trough angle expands carrying volume by up to 28% over 20° sets, significantly reducing spillage of granular free-flowing solids like dry silica sand, fine aggregate, and chemical fertilizers while keeping belt width narrower and capital costs lower.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Grade M24 and Grade N17 rubber conveyor belting under IS 1891?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indian Standard IS 1891 (Part 1) classifies conveyor belting based on tensile strength and rubber cover abrasion resistance. Grade M24 is the premium heavy-duty aggregate standard: it features a minimum tensile strength of 24 MPa, elongation at break of 450%, and an exceptionally low maximum volume abrasion loss of 150 mm³. This makes M24 mandatory for sharp, gouging, and highly abrasive materials such as crushed quartz stone, silica sand, and basalt aggregates. Grade N17 offers 17 MPa tensile strength and 200 mm³ abrasion loss, making it an economical choice for non-abrasive, rounded materials such as grains, compost, and bagged goods.

mainEntity.name: Why does Minerals Solutions hot-vulcanize diamond rubber lagging onto drive pulleys?

acceptedAnswer.text: In heavy industrial and outdoor quarry environments, bare steel drive pulleys suffer from severe frictional loss when wet or coated in stone dust, resulting in catastrophic belt slippage, belt burn, and motor stall. Minerals Solutions hot-vulcanizes 10mm to 12mm thick, 60–65 Shore A natural rubber onto the crowned steel pulley shell under high hydraulic pressure and heat, creating a chemical bond stronger than the rubber itself. The molded diamond herringbone grooving channels water, moisture, and slurry away from the belt-pulley interface, increasing the effective traction friction coefficient from 0.20 to over 0.38.

mainEntity.name: Can Minerals Solutions manufacture mobile wheel-mounted truck loading conveyor systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. In addition to stationary overland conveyors, our Zak GIDC, Dahegam facility engineers mobile wheel-mounted radial stackers and truck-loading belt conveyors. These mobile systems feature heavy tubular structural frames mounted on heavy-duty pneumatic tractor tyres, swivel wheel casters, and dual hydraulic hand-pump or electric lifting cylinders that allow continuous height adjustment from 2.5 meters to 7.5 meters. Equipped with heavy receiving hoppers and integrated towing tow-bars, they allow a single operator to load 30-tonne dumpers or bag-trucks in under 20 minutes.

What is an industrial troughed belt conveyor system? An industrial troughed belt conveyor system is a continuous bulk material handling installation designed in strict accordance with Bureau of Indian Standards (IS 11592) to convey crushed stone, silica sand, minerals, ores, and fertilizer pellets across horizontal and inclined paths up to 18 degrees. Fabricated in Zak GIDC, Dahegam from heavy structural IS 2062 channel stringers or welded lattice truss sections, the conveyor incorporates multi-ply nylon-nylon (NN) or polyester-polyamide (EP) rubber belting with Grade M24 wear covers. Heavy-duty three-roll troughing idlers (20°, 35°, or 45° angle) fitted with triple labyrinth dust seals and sealed-for-life deep-groove ball bearings ensure ultra-low rolling friction. Handling throughputs from 20 to 500 TPH at belt speeds between 0.8 and 2.5 m/s, systems feature diamond-groove rubber lagged drive drums for reliable slip-free power transmission. Structural Rigidity & Indian Standards Bulk Material Handling Engineering (IS 11592 Standards) Flimsy structural framing causes belt mistracking, premature edge fraying, and structural sagging under heavy stone loads. Minerals Solutions engineers every conveyor frame in strict compliance with IS 11592 code of practice for design and installation of troughed belt conveyors: Rigid ISMC Channel & Truss Frames Conveyors up to 30m utilize heavy ISMC 100 to 150 structural steel channel stringers. For spans exceeding 30m, we fabricate deep Warren or Pratt lattice trusses in angle and tubular steel, allowing clear unsupported spans up to 24 meters between support bents. Controlled Dynamic Deflection Structural frame deflection under full static plus dynamic 120% surge load is strictly restricted to less than L/500 of the span. This rigid baseline prevents stringer twist and ensures that idler rollers remain permanently perpendicular to the belt travel vector. Complete Integrated Safety Suite Every conveyor is equipped with bi-directional emergency pull-cord switches along both walkways, mechanical belt sway limit switches at head and tail sections, and an internal mechanical cam-clutch backstop preventing backward runaway on inclined runs. mainEntity.name: Why choose a double-pass concentric dryer over a single-pass drum for silica sand?

acceptedAnswer.text: A double-pass rotary dryer nests an inner drum inside an outer cylinder. Hot air travels through the inner cylinder and returns via the outer annular chamber, cutting radiated heat loss by up to 40% and requiring a significantly shorter factory bay footprint while maintaining complete access for maintenance.

mainEntity.name: How does the hydrocyclone prevent marketable fine sand from being lost in slurry ponds?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conventional bucket wheel washers lose valuable 75 to 150 micron sand particles through the overflow weir. Our closed-loop system pumps the overflow slurry to an overhead polyurethane hydrocyclone where centrifugal G-force separates fine sand from silt, returning the clean fines onto the dewatering screen.

mainEntity.name: Can this washing circuit produce plaster and concrete sand matching IS 383 specifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. By adjusting the hydrocyclone apex nozzle diameter and dewatering screen aperture sizes, the plant precisely controls silt content (under 3% by volume) and fine modulus to produce sand conforming to IS 383 Zone I, II, or III standards.

mainEntity.name: Can the washed sand be transferred directly into an industrial rotary dryer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because our high-frequency dewatering screen reduces sand moisture down to 12-14%, it can be transferred directly via trough belt conveyor into an industrial rotary sand dryer, dramatically cutting fuel consumption in downstream thermal drying.

mainEntity.name: What is the required water supply for a 50 TPH sand washing plant?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 50 TPH plant typically circulates 120 to 180 m³/hr of wash water. By integrating settling ponds or a compact lamella thickener, over 80% of this water is continuously recycled, requiring only 15-20% fresh make-up water.

mainEntity.name: When should a plant use a pan (disc) granulator versus a rotary drum granulator?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pan (disc) granulators are ideal for bio-organic compost and lines up to 5 TPH where operators need visual control over granule snowballing and high spherical uniformity (≥90%). Rotary drum granulators are favored for mega-tonnage chemical NPK plants (10 to 30 TPH) handling chemical slurry ammoniation.

mainEntity.name: How do you prevent heat damage to organic microbes during fertilizer drying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our rotary fertilizer dryers utilize co-current warm air flow (inlet temperatures carefully moderated between 100°C and 130°C) with high air volumes rather than scorching radiant heat. This gently drives off surface moisture down to 10-12% without degrading valuable humic acids or beneficial microbes.

mainEntity.name: What is the function of the rotary cooling and coating drum in the circuit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warm granules discharged from the dryer are prone to caking and clumping if bagged immediately. The rotary cooler lowers granule core temperatures to within 5°C of ambient, while the downstream coating drum coats each sphere with neem oil or talc powder to prevent moisture absorption in storage.

mainEntity.name: What is the required floor space for a 3 TPH complete granulation plant?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard 3 TPH turnkey bio-fertilizer line (including mixer, pan granulators, dryer, cooler, screening decks, and packaging) requires approximately 45 meters in length by 12 meters in width with a minimum 6-meter overhead crane clearance.

mainEntity.name: Why should rotary dryer support rollers be made from forged steel instead of cast steel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rotary dryers place severe 24/7 dynamic point-loading on support trunnions. Cast steel rollers often contain hidden subsurface casting porosity that spalls or cracks under thermal fatigue. Forged EN-8/EN-9 rollers offer unbroken grain flow and zero internal porosity, preventing sudden trunnion failure and protecting expensive riding rings.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of diamond rubber lagging on conveyor drive pulleys?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hot-vulcanized diamond grooved rubber lagging increases the friction coefficient between the conveyor belt and drive pulley from 0.20 to over 0.38, preventing belt slippage under wet quarry conditions and channeling water and slurry away from the belt contact zone.

mainEntity.name: How do your idler rollers resist dust and water ingress in abrasive mineral plants?

acceptedAnswer.text: All Minerals Solutions conveyor idlers incorporate a multi-stage labyrinth seal combined with a protective outer stone shield and deep-groove precision bearings pre-greased for life, ensuring smooth rotation without jamming under fine silica and mineral dust.

mainEntity.name: Can you fabricate custom replacement trunnions, girth gears, or pulleys to match existing plant drawings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our heavy machine shop in Zak GIDC manufactures custom split girth gears, drive pinions, shaft-mounted pulleys, and trunnion assemblies built precisely to sample, worn component dimensions, or engineering drawings.

# Minerals Solutions

> High-efficiency industrial rotary drum dryers, sand washing plants, fertilizer granulation plants, and material handling conveyor systems manufactured in Gujarat, India.

## Company Credentials & Grounding
- Legal Entity: Minerals Solutions (Established 2023)
- Proprietor: Mr. Vipulbhai A. Prajapati | CEO: Mr. P Amrutlal
- Heavy Fabrication Works: 10, Shyam Estate, Zak GIDC, Zak-Vahelal Road, Ta. Dahegam, Dist. Gandhinagar - 382330, Gujarat, India
- Geographic Coordinates: 23.1672° N, 72.8125° E (Ahmedabad Industrial Corridor)
- GSTIN: 24AUSPP9555F1ZZ | MSME UDYAM: UDYAM-GJ-09-0021428
- Direct Hotlines: +91 63524 53050, +91 91061 63058
- Official Inboxes: sales@mineralssolution.in, mineralssolutions76@gmail.com
- Canonical Website: https://mineralssolution.in/

## Core Equipment Catalog

### 1. Industrial Rotary Dryers & Thermal Systems
- Parent Hub: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/
- Configurations: Single-pass direct heat, concentric double-pass return drum, and triple-pass high-efficiency dryers.
- Throughput Capacity: 500 kg/hr to 50 TPH continuous duty.
- Metallurgy & Standards: Certified IS 2062 Grade B structural carbon steel (12mm to 25mm plate shell), optional SS 304 / SS 316 corrosive liners, Hardox 400 wear plates.
- Drive & Mechanics: Forged EN-8 / EN-9 alloy steel trunnion rollers induction hardened to 280-320 BHN, 42CrMo4 girth gear, Siemens/ABB IE3 energy-efficient motors.
- Applications: Silica sand, foundry sand, bauxite, river sand, bentonite, coal, sawdust, biomass, and chemical powders.
- Dedicated Spoke Lines:
  - Triple Pass Rotary Drum Dryer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/triple-pass-dryer/ (Model MS-TPD-1500 / MS-TPD-3000, 3 to 30 TPH, 30% to 40% thermal fuel savings)
  - Industrial Rotary Sand Dryer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/sand-dryer/ (Model MS-RSD-1200 / MS-RSD-2400, 5 to 45 TPH, discharge moisture below 0.5%)
  - Stainless Chemical Powder Dryer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/chemical-powder-dryer/ (Model MS-CPD-1000 / MS-CPD-2000, SS 304/SS 316 contact parts, zero cross-contamination)
  - Biomass & Sawdust Rotary Dryer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-rotary-dryers/biomass-sawdust-dryer/ (Model MS-BSD-1500 / MS-BSD-2800, 1 to 12 TPH, spark arrestor and explosion relief vents)

### 2. Sand Washing Plants & Hydrocyclone Separators
- Parent Hub: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/
- Configurations: Bucket wheel sand washers, high-pressure hydrocyclone desliming circuits, spiral screw sand classifiers, and high-frequency dewatering screens.
- Throughput Capacity: 30 TPH to 200 TPH.
- Silt Separation: Fines recovery down to 75 microns (200 mesh) with 12% to 15% moisture discharge.
- Resource Conservation: Integrated thickener and water recirculation delivering 75% to 80% water recovery.
- Dedicated Spoke Lines:
  - Silica Sand Washing Plant: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/silica-sand-washing-plant/ (Model MS-SWP-50 / MS-SWP-200, 30 to 200 TPH, silt content reduction below 0.5%)
  - Bucket Wheel Sand Washing Machine: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/bucket-wheel-sand-washer/ (Model MS-BWW-2600 / MS-BWW-3600, 40 to 180 TPH, wear-resistant polyurethane screen panels)
  - Hydrocyclone Fine Sand Recovery Unit: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/hydrocyclone-sand-separator/ (Model MS-FSR-60 / MS-FSR-120, 60 to 120 m³/hr slurry, 95%+ recovery of 75-150 micron fines)
  - Heavy Mineral Log Washer: https://mineralssolution.in/products/sand-washing-plants/mineral-log-washer/ (Model MS-LW-1000 / MS-LW-2000, 30 to 150 TPH, twin-shaft Hi-Cr paddles for tough plastic clay scrubbing)

### 3. Fertilizer Granulation & Pellet Plants
- Parent Hub: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/
- Configurations: Disc pan granulators with stepless tilt angle (40° to 55°), rotary drum granulators, rotary coolers, and rotary anti-caking coating drums.
- Throughput Capacity: 1 TPH to 20 TPH turnkey lines.
- Yield & Sizing: 2.0 mm to 4.5 mm spherical granule yield above 92%.
- Applications: Bio-organic compost, vermicompost, NPK chemical fertilizers, DAP compounds, and city compost.
- Dedicated Spoke Lines:
  - Industrial Pan Disc Fertilizer Granulator: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/disc-granulator/ (Model MS-PG-2200 / MS-PG-3600, 1 to 8 TPH, 40° to 55° adjustable angle, 93%+ round pellets)
  - Double Roller Compaction Granulator: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/double-roller-granulator/ (Model MS-DRG-1000 / MS-DRG-3000, 1 to 5 TPH, room-temperature dry granulation, zero fuel)
  - Industrial Rotary Drum Granulator: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/rotary-drum-granulator/ (Model MS-RDG-1500 / MS-RDG-2500, 3 to 20 TPH, continuous tumbling agglomeration, UHMWPE liner)
  - Fertilizer Cooling & Anti-Caking Coating Drum: https://mineralssolution.in/products/fertilizer-granulation-plants/fertilizer-cooling-coating-drum/ (Model MS-CCD-1200 / MS-CCD-2200, dual-stage cooling and micronized oil coating)

### 4. Industrial Conveyors & Heavy Mechanical Spares
- Parent Hub: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/
- Equipment: Heavy trough belt conveyors, chevron steep-incline conveyors, diamond/herringbone rubber-lagged drive pulleys, CEMA-C/D labyrinth-sealed idlers.
- Spares & Metallurgy: Replacement forged EN-8/EN-9 trunnion tyre assemblies, custom spur/helical girth gears, pillow block spherical roller bearings (SKF/FAG).
- Dedicated Spoke Lines:
  - Heavy Duty Industrial Bucket Elevator Systems: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/bucket-elevators/ (Model MS-BEL-Centrifugal & MS-BEL-Continuous, 5 to 150 TPH, up to 45m vertical lift)
  - Industrial U-Trough & Tubular Screw Conveyor: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/screw-conveyors/ (Model MS-SC-200 / MS-SC-500, 3 to 50 TPH, dust-tight enclosed powder transfer)
  - Forged Steel Rotary Dryer Support Rollers & Tyres: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/forged-trunnion-rollers/ (Model MS-TR-400 / MS-TR-1000, forged 42CrMo4/EN-9, 280-320 BHN, ultrasonic tested)
  - Industrial Troughed Belt Conveyor Systems: https://mineralssolution.in/products/industrial-conveyors-spares/belt-conveyors/ (Model MS-BC-500 / MS-BC-1200, 20 to 500 TPH, IS 11592 compliance, CEMA-C/D idlers)

## Key Website & Conversion Endpoints
- Homepage: https://mineralssolution.in/
- Manufacturing Facility & Machinery Proof: https://mineralssolution.in/manufacturing/
- Industries Served: https://mineralssolution.in/industries/
- About Company: https://mineralssolution.in/about/
- Direct Machinery Quotation: https://mineralssolution.in/request-quote/
- Works Contact & Visiting Desk: https://mineralssolution.in/contact/
- XML Sitemap: https://mineralssolution.in/sitemap.xml
